description: The line plot illustrates the “Harmful with Refusal Ratio” across four model configurations as a function of input context length, measured at 128, 256, 512, and 1024 tokens. The x-axis is linear, ranging from 128 to 1024 with tick marks at each specified value. The y-axis, labeled “Harmful with Refusal Ratio,” is also linear, spanning from 0.0 to 0.5 in increments of 0.1. Four distinct lines represent different model-benchmark combinations: LLaVA-1.5-7B on FigStep (blue circles, solid line) starts at ~0.20 at 128 tokens, rises to ~0.25 at 256, then plateaus near 0.35 from 512 to 1024. Qwen2-VL-7B on FigStep (orange squares, solid line) begins at ~0.15, climbs to ~0.23 at 256, then jumps to ~0.42 at 512 and remains flat at 1024. LLaVA-1.5-7B on MMSafetyBench (green triangles, solid line) starts low at ~0.07, rises sharply to ~0.22 at 256, then increases more gradually to ~0.37 at 512 and ~0.38 at 1024. Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench (red diamonds, solid line) begins at ~0.24, rises to ~0.27 at 256, then climbs steeply to ~0.42 at 512 and continues upward to ~0.52 at 1024. All lines show an increasing or plateauing trend with longer context, with Qwen2-VL-7B on MMSafetyBench exhibiting the steepest overall increase and highest final value.
